title: Area of Triangles - Linked to Squares and Rectangles
subject: Mathematics

questions.question: A rectangle has length 10 cm and width 6 cm. A triangle is drawn inside it with the same base and height. What is the area of the triangle?
questions.explanation: Rectangle area = 10 × 6 = 60 cm². Triangle area = ½ × rectangle area = ½ × 60 = 30 cm². Or: ½ × 10 × 6 = 30 cm².

questions.question: A square has side 8 cm. A triangle is drawn inside it with the same base and height. What is the area of the triangle?
questions.explanation: Square area = 8 × 8 = 64 cm². Triangle area = ½ × 64 = 32 cm². Or: ½ × 8 × 8 = 32 cm².

questions.question: Find the area of a triangle with base 12 cm and height 8 cm.
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 12 × 8 = 48 cm².

questions.question: A rectangle has area 80 cm². A triangle with the same base and height is drawn inside it. What is the area of the triangle?
questions.explanation: Triangle area = ½ × rectangle area = ½ × 80 = 40 cm².

questions.question: A triangle has base 15 cm and height 4 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × 15 × 4 = 30 cm².

questions.question: A square has area 100 cm². A triangle with the same base and height is drawn inside it. What is the area of the triangle?
questions.explanation: Triangle area = ½ × square area = ½ × 100 = 50 cm².

questions.question: The area of a triangle is 24 cm². If the height is 6 cm, what is the base?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height. 24 = ½ × base × 6. 24 = 3 × base. Base = 24 ÷ 3 = 8 cm.

questions.question: A rectangle has length 14 cm and width 10 cm. What is the area of a triangle with the same base and height?
questions.explanation: Rectangle area = 14 × 10 = 140 cm². Triangle area = ½ × 140 = 70 cm².

questions.question: A triangle has area 36 cm² and base 9 cm. What is its height?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height. 36 = ½ × 9 × height. 36 = 4.5 × height. Height = 36 ÷ 4.5 = 8 cm.

questions.question: Two identical triangles can be joined to form a rectangle with length 16 cm and width 5 cm. What is the area of one triangle?
questions.explanation: Rectangle area = 16 × 5 = 80 cm². One triangle = ½ × 80 = 40 cm².

questions.question: A triangle has base 20 cm and height 3 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × 20 × 3 = 30 cm².

questions.question: A square has side 12 cm. A triangle is drawn inside it with the same base and height. What is the area of the triangle?
questions.explanation: Square area = 12 × 12 = 144 cm². Triangle area = ½ × 144 = 72 cm².

questions.question: The area of a triangle is 48 cm². If the base is 12 cm, what is the height?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height. 48 = ½ × 12 × height. 48 = 6 × height. Height = 48 ÷ 6 = 8 cm.

questions.question: A rectangle has area 120 cm². A triangle with the same base and height is drawn inside it. What is the area of the triangle?
questions.explanation: Triangle area = ½ × rectangle area = ½ × 120 = 60 cm².

questions.question: Find the area of a triangle with base 18 cm and height 6 cm.
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × 18 × 6 = 54 cm².

questions.question: A triangle has area 50 cm² and height 10 cm. What is its base?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height. 50 = ½ × base × 10. 50 = 5 × base. Base = 50 ÷ 5 = 10 cm.

questions.question: A rectangular garden is 10 m long and 8 m wide. A triangular flower bed with the same base and height is inside it. What is the area of the flower bed?
questions.explanation: Rectangle area = 10 × 8 = 80 m². Triangle area = ½ × 80 = 40 m².

questions.question: A triangle has base 16 cm and height 5 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × 16 × 5 = 40 cm².

questions.question: The area of a triangle is 60 cm². If the height is 12 cm, what is the base?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height. 60 = ½ × base × 12. 60 = 6 × base. Base = 60 ÷ 6 = 10 cm.

questions.question: Two identical triangles form a square with side 14 cm. What is the area of one triangle?
questions.explanation: Square area = 14 × 14 = 196 cm². One triangle = ½ × 196 = 98 cm².
